title: AddFurniture Command
description: Add one piece from the furniture catalogue (forsk.furniture.v1): a block FORSK_FU_<catalog_id> on A-FURN (fixed kitchen and bathroom pieces on A-FURN-FIXD) with forsk:kind=furniture, forsk:id F01, forsk:catalog_id and forsk:room. item is a catalogue id or words (double bed, sofa, toilet); width (cm under 300, else mm) and seats pick the nearest size. room names the room (id, name, or a room type with one room); else the room holding at, else the picked room, else the only room. A wall piece stands back to the longest free wall, centred, sliding along it; a free piece (tables, chairs, island) stands in the middle, turned along the longest wall. at with rotation places its centre exactly. A piece that does not fit is refused with the reason. Plan sheets draw its 2D symbol.

item.description: Catalogue id (bed.double.160x200) or words (double bed, sofa, WC).

width.description: Nominal width: cm under 300, else mm. Picks the nearest size.

seats.description: Seats, for sofas and tables. Picks the nearest size.

room.description: The room: its id (R01), its name, or a room type when only one room has it.

at.description: [x, y] in mm: the wall or spot nearest to it first; with rotation, the piece's centre.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise, of the piece's back edge from world x. Only with at.
